motion.name: testimonials-first-lane
motion.purpose: Translate duplicated groups to -50%; hover and active press pause at the current transform. Keyboard-visible focus removes animation, hides copies and enables manual horizontal scrolling.

motion.name: testimonials-second-lane
motion.purpose: Opposing second lane with the same pause and keyboard behavior. Reduced motion removes both animations and copies, leaving manual horizontal scrolling.

breakpoints.name: testimonials-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum mobile width: rows fit within viewport minus 48px; row and lane gaps are 24px. Shared desktop boundary remains 640px.

components.name: Landing testimonial source row
components.description: Transparent native message row using MessageAuthorLine proportions and the shared 40px Avatar. This isolated preview shows the shipped initials fallback and source affordance; lane motion and its accessible copy behavior are recorded in the extension metadata. Landing-token fallbacks reproduce the scoped landing values outside that page.

components.css: .ds-testimonial-preview { padding: 16px; background: var(--landing-bg, #f4f9e9); } .ds-testimonial-message { display: flex; width: 360px; max-width: calc(100vw - 48px); min-height: 44px; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--landing-text, #1b271f); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-testimonial-message:hover, .ds-testimonial-message:focus-visible { background: var(--landing-surface, #ddedb7); } .ds-testimonial-message:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--landing-text, #1b271f); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-testimonial-avatar { display: flex; position: relative; width: 40px; height: 40px; flex-shrink: 0; align-self: flex-start; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--landing-surface, #ddedb7); color: var(--landing-text-muted, #47633b); font-size: 14px; } .ds-testimonial-avatar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50%; mix-blend-mode: darken; } .ds-testimonial-body { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; } .ds-testimonial-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-testimonial-name { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-testimonial-source-icon { flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--landing-text-muted, #47633b); } .ds-testimonial-handle { color: var(--landing-text-muted, #47633b); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-testimonial-body blockquote { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; overflow: hidden; margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.375; overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: pre-line; } .ds-testimonial-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

narrative.overview: A landing-only extension of the inherited green/CRT world, immediately before the FAQ.

rules.name: The Native Attribution Rule
rules.body: Keep the source arrow beside the name, with both vertically centered in the author row and an 8px gap.

rules.name: The Readable Motion Rule
rules.body: Preserve both opposing lanes (100s forward and 110s reverse, linear and continuous).

rules.name: The Single Reading Copy Rule
rules.body: Expose the 20 original source links once to assistive technology and keyboard navigation.
